name: 3853-mixedprefill-13b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, SM90. The node is taken exclusively.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1. One in-process vLLM engine on a single GPU, no NCCL, no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: constant (open loop), 8 requests/second, bounded at 1000 requests with a 900 s safety cap and a 20% warmup.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, every request exactly 550 prompt tokens in and 150 output tokens out, `ignore_eos` so the output length is pinned rather than sampled, prefix caching off, greedy sampling.
purpose: A 13-billion-parameter chat assistant giving uniform short answers to half-page prompts at eight requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
model: NousResearch/Llama-2-13b-hf
dtype: float16
seed: 3853

tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1

max-model-len: 2048
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 256
enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
